name: arrow-runner
description: Arrow Runner - High-speed 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas arcade game packaged for Android via Capacitor 7

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'www/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'www/manifest.json');"
